symptoms: Xvfb dependency causing failures on macOS
Slow startup due to spawning Chrome just to detect version/UA

summary: Native Chrome headless mode on macOS (no Xvfb)
Avoid spawning Chrome during startup for version detection
Persist UA cache keyed by Chrome major version
macOS-specific fast paths guarded by sys.platform == 'darwin'

key_changes.description: Read Chrome version from macOS app bundle Info.plist instead of running `chrome --version`
Prefer /Applications/Google Chrome.app and Chromium.app on macOS
macOS uses native Chrome headless; Xvfb only attempted on Linux
Persist UA to disk and reuse if Chrome major version matches

non_changes: No env-based DRIVER switching logic required

notes: DRIVER=uc is ignored on official master; safe to remove
DISPLAY may exist in inherited env but is not used
resource_tracker warnings are harmless shutdown noise

browser_test: PYTHONPATH=src python -c "import logging; logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO); import flaresolverr_service as s; s.test_browser_installation()"

git_workflow.rationale: Isolate macOS-specific optimizations; keep master clean
commands: git commit -m "macOS: headless Chrome optimizations; avoid Xvfb; plist version fast path"

design_principles: Prefer platform-specific fast paths over environment variables
Avoid deleting cross-platform code unless provably unreachable
Optimize for launchd stability and zero GUI artifacts
Keep diffs small to reduce rebase friction
